categories.main_business_segments: POWERCOM Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, including On-line UPS, Line-Interactive UPS, Functional UPS, power equipment/accessories, and maintenance services. The company also develops solar inverters and provides solar power plant design, installation, and maintenance services. Their products serve a wide range of applications from households and commercial offices to industrial plants, data centers, medical equipment, and public facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on UPS technology with developments in high-density, low energy consumption, high stability, and long durability UPS products. Production involves procurement of components such as batteries, transformers, PCBs, and microprocessors, followed by assembly, inspection, and testing processes. They also develop solar inverter technology and maintain solar power plants with communication and monitoring systems. R&D efforts include advanced ATS models, super capacitor UPS, and energy storage models, emphasizing energy-saving designs and high-efficiency equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: POWERCOM serves a global customer base including distributors and resellers in over 40 countries across Asia (Japan, South Korea, Philippines, Israel, Hong Kong, Singapore), Europe (Germany, Ukraine, Italy), Americas (USA, Canada, Argentina), and Oceania (Australia). Key customers include multinational corporations and government agencies requiring reliable power solutions for IT, telecom, industrial, medical, military, and public infrastructure sectors. The company also targets OEM and ODM markets and solar energy system clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in New Taipei City and Zhonghe District. Its sales and services cover Asia-Pacific countries, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, with nearly 700 midstream distributors and resellers worldwide. The Asia-Pacific region holds a significant market share in the UPS industry, aligning with POWERCOM's strategic focus on these markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: POWERCOM operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, assembly, and marketing of UPS and solar inverter products. It sources raw materials such as batteries, transformers, PCBs, and microprocessors from upstream suppliers and sells finished products to downstream distributors and end-users. The company also provides after-sales and customized services, integrating upstream supplier relationships to enhance competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in UPS products to enhance energy efficiency, stability, and durability, with ongoing development of high-specification models and improved communication interfaces. It integrates R&D resources to produce customized products and expand partnerships with large-scale distributors globally. POWERCOM emphasizes ESG and sustainable development, focusing on energy conservation, carbon reduction, and environmental responsibility. R&D expenses accounted for approximately 4.7% of operating revenue in 2024.
categories.revenue_model: POWERCOM generates revenue primarily through the sale of UPS products and related power equipment, solar inverters, and maintenance services. The company operates on a product sales model, including OEM and ODM customized solutions. Revenue is derived from global sales to distributors, resellers, and end customers across various industries. The company also benefits from financial income related to investments and foreign exchange gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: POWERCOM positions itself as a reputable and experienced player in the UPS and solar inverter markets with over 35 years of brand presence. It competes by leveraging strong upstream supplier relationships, competitive pricing, high product quality, and comprehensive after-sales services. The company faces competition from Chinese manufacturers and global UPS providers but differentiates through customization capabilities, product reliability, and focus on sustainable energy solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, POWERCOM reported operating revenue of approximately NT$882 million, a 33.5% decrease from 2023, primarily due to inventory clearance and reduced sales. Despite the revenue decline, net profit after tax increased significantly to NT$36.3 million from a loss in the prior year, driven by foreign exchange gains and cost control. Total assets grew by 23.8% to NT$1.59 billion, and shareholders' equity increased by 53.5% to NT$605 million. The company maintains a stable workforce of around 190 employees with ongoing investments in R&D and sustainability initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: POWERCOM emphasizes product reliability, high quality, and customization to meet diverse customer needs across various sectors. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive after-sales support, and integration of energy-saving and environmentally friendly technologies. The company’s commitment to ESG principles, sustainable development, and compliance with international standards further differentiates its offerings. Its long-standing brand reputation and strategic partnerships enable it to provide tailored power solutions with superior performance and service.
